surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: filename argument.
TRUST: reports_root is the trusted approved root; filename is untrusted user input.
SINK: Opening and reading a file beneath reports_root.
GUARD: Reject if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link; canonicalize the joined path and verify it remains strictly inside reports_root; ensure the target is an ordinary file.
ORDER: Join filename to reports_root, canonicalize, verify containment under reports_root, verify no user-selected path component is a symlink, then open and read UTF-8 content.
EFFECT: Return the file text; propagate FileNotFoundError if the ordinary file is missing; raise ValueError for traversal outside the root, symlink components, or non-ordinary files.
END_PLAN
